purpose: Research (round 2): replicate 6 of the exact r1-012 setup (A-A at rest, x 4.0 and 6.0, y 5.0, dt 0.005, T 1.5). Question: is the post-contact outcome (ejected = post-contact max >= 5, bound = < 3, 3 to 5 no verdict) a per-run random event? Pre-registered: among the 8 replicates, ejections f with 1 <= f <= 5 means per-run randomness with p in about 0.1 to 0.6; f = 0 means 012 was an outlier; f = 8 means ejection is the usual outcome.
